==Overview==
* Imperial treasury during this season announced by the Civil Service at 1514 thrones and 4 crowns.
* The following has been donated to the Imperial treasury:
** 75 thrones were returned to the treasury by '''Hengest Dun''' as the [[Construct Runeforge|motion]] the funds were received for has expired
** 10 thrones were contributed to the treasury by '''Hengest Dun''' to cover the costs to [[dispatch prospectors to the Pride of Ikka's Tears]]
** 30 thrones donated to the Senate treasury by '''Thanmir Hrafnar''' after the Spring Equinox 382YE
** 60 thrones donated to the Senate treasury by '''Imperatrix Lisabetta von Holberg''' after the Spring Equinox 382YE

==Administrative==
This administrative motion was raised as the first order of business at the first Senate session on Friday.

==Announcements==
* [[The_Throne#The_Hand_of_the_Chancellor|Hand of the Chancellor]] was exercised by [[Empress Lisabetta|Imperatrix Lisabetta]] to the amount of 504 Thrones and 4 Crowns.
* The Quartermaster General announced that the Imperial Guerdon for Spring 382 is to go to the following armies: The Wolves of War, The Fire of the South, the Bloodcloaks, and the Tusks.
* The intention to [[The_Throne#Address_the_Empire|address the Empire]] was announced by [[Empress Lisabetta|Imperatrix Lisabetta]], but was later withdrawn.
* Research into anomalous conjunctions, particularly the last conjunction of Empress Britta was announced by the [[Minister of Historical Research]].
* Research into the past Life of Adelina Barossa was announced by the Minister of Historical Research.
===Commissions===
A total of 14 [[commission|commissions]] were announced during the Winter Solstice: 9 standard commissions, 3 wayleaves, and 2 under the auspices of [[Those_who_worship#Almodin_Okt.C3.ADstis.2C_Priest_of_the_Builder|Almodin Oktístis]].
* An announcement by the [[Arcane Architect]] of intention to [[Construct summer sinecure|construct a summer vis sinecure]] in [[Reikos]].
* An announcement by Selenius, [[bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]], to [[Construct Peak Edge trading enclave|construct a trading enclave in Peak Edge]].
* An announcement by Jorgen Brenna, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, to [[Construct Brenna’s Gift]].
* An announcement by Lorenzo La Volpe, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, to [[Construct the Azure Chorus]]. .
